episodes.text: Cut the nightly billing run from six hours to forty minutes by rewriting the reconciliation job.
Shipped a schema change without a backfill and left invoicing wrong for two days before anyone noticed.

stories.text: Led the move of the billing system off the mainframe onto PostgreSQL.
Ran the municipal permits API alone for two years.
